hp.name: Health
hp.regen: none passive (potions/food/heals/beds/campsite); alpha entity default 500 x multipliers

mp.name: Mana
mp.gain: warrior hits+blocks; ranger hits (+sniper stealth); rogue hits/shuriken (+assassin stealth, ninja dodges +25); mage passive regen
mp.spend: special attacks (charged amount), intercept, teleport (100), fire explosion 50, healing stream ~50, mage M2 30
mp.display: bar turns pink for amount to be spent while charging

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.spend: dodge 25, climbing drain, glider level-off, sprint drain, cyclone 25+25/s, smash 100, kick 50, high jump 25, shuriken 25, retreat/poison vial all, wall-jump (S)

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.effect: up to +20% attack power, +50% crit, faster MP; near-zero aggro at full; decays when not generated

diving-breath.name: Diving Stamina
diving-breath.effect: depletes underwater; empty → HP loss; wall hold pauses; artifacts extend

pet-hydration.name: Pet Hydration
pet-hydration.effect: droplets under pet HP; drains while riding; refill in any water

armor.name: Armor
armor.effect: physical reduction; 'no damage if armor > attack' (?); pierced progressively by combo

crit.name: Critical
crit.effect: chance for bonus damage; x2.0, chance above 100% adds to the multiplier (D6, generators.json#design.crit)

weapon-rating.name: Weapon Level/Rating
weapon-rating.formula: average star tier of equipped weapons

armor-rating.name: Armor Level/Rating
armor-rating.formula: average star tier of equipped armor

alpha-item-stat-formulas.hp: curve(n,r) * 5 * slot * (2 - 8*r + matBonus)   slot: chest 1.0 else 0.5; matBonus iron 1, cotton 0.75, linen 0.5
alpha-item-stat-formulas.armor: curve(n,r) * slot * matMult   (saurian 0.8, parrot/linen/cotton 0.85, licht/silk 0.75, iron 1.0)
alpha-item-stat-formulas.crit: curve2(level,r) * (0.1 two-handed & chest | 0.05 other) * (1 - r + gold 1)
alpha-item-stat-formulas.consumable-heal: curve(level,r) * 200 (life/cactus potion, ginseng soup, snowberry mash, mushroom spit) | * 100 (pineapple slice, pumpkin muffin)

alpha-character-formulas.player-hp: base-hp * 2 * max_hp_multiplier(100) * class-mult   (warrior 1.30 [guardian x1.25], ranger 1.10, rogue 1.20, mage 1.0)
